A '''hospital''' was located in [[Wormstew Town]] on<ref name="Star Wars 34" /> the [[Hutt Space]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> [[moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="Star Wars 34" /> Around [[1 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> the [[Medcenter|hospital]] was in danger of closing down until<ref name="Star Wars 34" /> the [[smuggler]] [[Sana Starros]]<ref name="Timelines" />—who had grown up in Wormstew Town<ref name="Star Wars 34" />—donated her cut of 45,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]]<ref name="Timelines" /> in a dozen sacks to the hospital, leaving them on its doorsteps.<ref name="Star Wars 34" />

Later, Starros overheard a trio of individuals talking, with [[Unidentified individual (Wormstew Town)|one]] asking their [[Unidentified Arcona (Nar Shaddaa)|two]] [[Unidentified tendril-faced individual|companions]] if they had heard about the hospital in Wormstew Town. Their [[Arcona]] companion responded that they had heard that someone had left sacks of credits at the hospital, suggesting to the others that it might not have to close after all. A third individual then laughed and questioned if the Arcona believed what they had heard, adding that heroes did not exist in such places as Nar Shaddaa.<ref name="Star Wars 34" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Wormstew Town hospital was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars (2015) 34|thirty-fourth issue]] of the [[2015]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series [[Star Wars (2015)|''Star Wars'']]. The issue was written by [[Jason Aaron]] and published by [[Marvel Comics]]<ref name="Star Wars 34" /> on [[August 16]], [[2017]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/60817/star_wars_2015_34|text=Star Wars (2015) #34}}</ref>
